summary: Completed testing of bug fixes for SignGuy AI. All reported user issues have been fixed and verified: Payroll/Financials access (Business tier), Job row clickability, Pricing calculator zeros/complexity slider, Setup fee charging, and AI Tools functionality.

minor.issue: Endpoints return 404 - routes not implemented in backend. Frontend handles gracefully with empty state.

tier_upgrade.details: User testowner2@signshop.com confirmed to have 'business' tier. /api/tiers/my-plan returns tier: 'business', tier_display_name: 'Business'

payroll_access.details: Payroll page accessible with Business tier. Employee ledger, balance info, and payroll report displayed correctly.

financials_access.details: Financials page accessible with Business tier. Enter Daily Sales and Add Expense buttons visible. Page handles API 404 gracefully.

job_row_click.details: Job row is fully clickable with data-testid='job-row-{id}'. Clicking navigates to /jobs/{id} details page.

pricing_calculator_zeros.details: Calculator shows $0.00 values initially. Sq Ft shows 0.00 before dimensions entered.

complexity_slider.details: Complexity slider (1-10) affects price. Tested via API: complexity=1 gives $181.88, complexity=10 gives $591.09 (complexity_multiplier 1.0 vs 3.25)

setup_fee_once.details: Setup fee charged once per order. API confirmed: setup_cost=$25 for both qty=1 and qty=10

ai_tools_page.details: AI Tools page loads with 15 tools across 4 categories (Design Tools, Branding, Business, Marketing). Generate button visible.

ai_text_generation.details: Tagline generator works. API returned 10 creative taglines for test input.

sidebar_tier_badge.details: Business tier badge visible in bottom-right corner of sidebar

action_items: OPTIONAL: Implement /api/financials/sales, /api/financials/expenses, /api/financials/summary backend routes if financial data entry is needed (currently frontend shows empty state)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ClickTest_Customer and TEST_JobRowClick_Test job for testing job row click
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 reported bugs verified fixed. Business tier working for testowner2@signshop.com. AI tools using OpenAI GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM key. Pricing calculator complexity multiplier working (1.0x to 3.25x). Setup fee correctly charged once per order.

bugs_fixed: Tier access - Payroll/Financials now accessible with Business tier
Job row clickability - Full row is clickable, navigates to job details
Calculator zeros - Shows $0.00 initially before category selection
Complexity slider - Affects price (tested: $181.88 at 1 vs $591.09 at 10)
Setup fee - Charged once per order, not multiplied by quantity
AI Tools - Page accessible, 15 tools available, text generation working
